  - [1mPart[0m [1m1[0m [1mdoesn't[0m [1mfix[0m [1mitem 15.[0m The real finished-turn line already passes the screen check today, so T4 is a guard. The run records keep only the error code, so
    it can't be shown what refused item 15.
  - [1mLive[0m [1mspinner[0m [1mwording.[0m Today's live spinner has no [38;5;153mesc[39m [38;5;153mto[39m [38;5;153minterrupt[39m; it reads [38;5;153m(8s[39m [38;5;153m·[39m [38;5;153m↓[39m [38;5;153m381[39m [38;5;153mtokens)[39m.     the wording the acceptance criterion names.
  - [1mNo backoff.[0m "The existing backoff" doesn't exist: a re-parked resume just waits for the next turn end or [38;5;153madvance[39m tick. No timer is added; item 10 owns real
    backoff.

  One gap remains: when these codes come back on a first dispatch or a sweep redelivery, the run still waits for a person, because the sweep's list of retryable
  codes is left alone on purpose. Item 04's last failure was one of these, so this plan would not have saved that run either. I've left it for item 10.

  I sent the done notification.
